notes: Recorded because the lane asks for programmes a solo person can enter without an entity, and Zindi is the cheapest such door to enter: an email, a public notebook, no card. The honest limits are the size and the disclosure gap: five awards totalling USD 10,000 against 1,385 participants, and an eligibility note on the listing page whose content is not repeated on the listing. Two readings of that note were considered: it is boilerplate about prize-transfer compliance, or it hides a jurisdiction limit on a US-census-based dataset. The challenge body read today states no country restriction and explicitly allows individual entry, which supports the first; a reader who needs certainty should open the same challenge's rules tab, which was not read.
